recognize_zh: 數顆成熟嗜中性球的核只有兩葉，呈眼鏡狀或花生狀（左下與下方中央的細胞最明顯），染色質粗糙濃縮，細胞質仍保有顆粒，這種雙葉低分葉的成熟顆粒球稱為假性 Pelger-Huët 細胞（pseudo-Pelger-Huët cells）。
features: Mature neutrophils with bilobed (spectacle/pince-nez) nuclei connected by a thin bridge
Coarse, markedly condensed chromatin inappropriate for a band stage
Cytoplasmic granulation retained in the hyposegmented cells
Adjacent granulocytic precursors (promyelocyte/myelocyte with coarse granules, right) and a basophilic early erythroid precursor (bottom)
Aspirate background with erythrocytes and debris
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Several mature neutrophils display hyposegmented, bilobed spectacle-shaped nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin while retaining cytoplasmic granules, consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët change. A promyelocyte/myelocyte and an early erythroid precursor are also present, and blasts are not increased in this field. In a reactive setting these cells may reflect drug effect (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, valproate) or infection, but myelodysplastic neoplasm should be excluded clinically and with cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: Nearly all neutrophils are uniformly bilobed or non-lobed with normal granulation, the change is lifelong, and there is no cytopenia or dysplasia in other lineages.
Pseudo-Pelger cells are accompanied by hypogranulation, dysplasia in other lineages, cytopenias and often clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Bands have a continuous non-segmented horseshoe nucleus with less condensed chromatin rather than two discrete lobes with a thin filament.
Morphology is identical to MDS-related change; resolution after withdrawal of the offending drug supports a reactive cause.
